Amosense.why: Makes thin-film large-area ceramic electrolyte substrates for solid-oxide fuel cells (SOFC), the onsite-power technology deployed at AI data centers; growth in SOFC distributed power lifts demand for its substrates.
Amosense.evidence: Amosense Q2 FY2026 (08-14-2026) half-year report, II. Business / 7. New business: ceramic substrates include SOFC electrolyte substrates (thin-film, large-area, uniform thickness, multi-layer stacking & sintering); management cites grid-expansion delays and growing interest in SOFC as a distributed power solution.

players.product: SOFC ceramic electrolyte substrates (thin-film, large-area; also Si3N4 power-module substrates)

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: H1 2026 revenue KRW 55,003,233,082 (H1 2025: KRW 60,210,779,073) and an operating loss of KRW 887,333,396 (H1 2025: operating profit KRW 2,821,486,335); Q2 2026 revenue KRW 27,178,504,647 (Q2 2025: KRW 29,065,743,868) with a Q2 operating loss of KRW 1,418,750,302 (Q2 2025: operating profit KRW 1,288,927,366); H1 net loss KRW 1,424,637,813. H1 product revenue by segment (KRW M): materials 9,463, modules 32,906, devices & platform 9,769, other 1,559; exports 11,895 and domestic 43,108. The largest products by revenue are wireless-charging shielding sheets, automotive and RF modules and IoT devices
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue KRW 55,003,233,082; operating loss KRW 887,333,396

quarterly_data.signal: Ceramic substrates (SOFC electrolyte substrates, Si3N4 substrates, LTCC substrates, piezoelectric ceramics) sit in the materials segment. The company describes its SOFC ceramic substrate as a thin-film, large-area ceramic substrate of uniform thickness made with its own multi-layer stacking & sintering technology, improving SOFC durability and performance. Management: with grid-expansion delays highlighted, interest in distributed power near demand sites is growing and SOFC is drawing attention as a distributed power solution where power demand is rising fast; the company is expanding development and commercialisation of the products in response to market growth. No SOFC revenue or customer is disclosed

Customers above 10% of H1 2026 revenue (not named): Customer A KRW 15,042,942 thousand (27.35%) and Customer B KRW 30,268,983 thousand (55.03%). Related-party sales to Amotech, which holds significant influence over the company, were KRW 15,042,942 thousand in H1 2026 (H1 2025: KRW 20,824,220 thousand), and inventory purchases from Amotech KRW 7,028,310 thousand
quarterly_data.figure: Customer B 55.03%, Customer A 27.35% of H1 revenue
quarterly_data.counterparty: undisclosed Customers A and B; Amotech

quarterly_data.signal: Si3N4 ceramic substrates are being developed for EV AMB power modules along a raw powder-substrate-module value chain; the convergence technology lab is developing high-power 5G substrates, autonomous-vehicle substrates, GaN power substrates and hydrogen-sensor elements. H1 2026 R&D spending KRW 9,840,738 thousand (16.24% of revenue); 1,283 patents and applications held at June 30, 2026
